CZ/SK Bank File Formats — Shared Builders

The ABO and MultiCash file writers and the Czech account-number parser shared by the bank-file modules.

Version19.0.1.3.2
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresbase_iban
Extended byaccount_abo, account_abo_batch, account_fio_base, account_kb_best_base, account_multicash, account_multicash_batch, account_payment_kb_sepa, account_payment_tatrabanka (delivered separately), account_payment_tatrabanka_batch (delivered separately), account_statement_import_gpc, account_statement_import_gpc_ee, account_statement_import_mt940
This module is part of a family documented in one place. The full guide: account_abo

Holds the ABO and MultiCash payment-file writers, so the Community (payment order) and Enterprise (batch payment) variants produce identical files, together with the reading of Czech account numbers in both spellings (IBAN and prefix-number/bank code) and of VS:/KS:/SS: tokens in a payment's text. The KB BEST and Fio modules and the MT940 and KB statement imports use the same account parser.

It has no screen and no settings. It is installed as a dependency of the modules that need it.
